breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification assigns a uniform internal axial force of 30,000 N to all three segments (AB, BC, CD). This directly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The correct piecewise values are N_AB = 30,000 N, N_BC = 12,000 N, and N_CD = 20,000 N, since point loads cause jumps in the axial force diagram.

breakdown.reason: The generated specification computes a single stress level (150 MPa) for all segments and a single displacement (1.35 mm), which mirrors the net-load reduction error. The correct segment stresses are σ_AB = 150 MPa, σ_BC = 60 MPa, σ_CD = 100 MPa, and the correct displacement of D is approximately 0.955 mm.
